items.heading: Pho
details: Key ingredients: rice noodles, beef or chicken, star anise, cinnamon, ginger, herbs
Simmer bones with charred ginger, star anise and cinnamon for a fragrant broth.
Strain the broth and season with fish sauce.
Cook rice noodles separately and place in bowls with thin raw meat slices.
Ladle hot broth over to cook the meat, then top with fresh herbs and lime.

items.heading: Spring Rolls
details: Key ingredients: rice paper, shrimp or pork, rice vermicelli, lettuce, herbs
Soften rice paper briefly in warm water.
Layer lettuce, herbs, vermicelli and shrimp or pork on top.
Roll tightly, tucking in the sides.
Serve fresh with a peanut or fish sauce dip.

items.heading: Banh Mi
details: Key ingredients: baguette, pate, pickled vegetables, cilantro, chili, meat of choice
Split a crisp baguette and spread with pate and mayonnaise.
Layer in cooked meat and quick-pickled carrot and daikon.
Add fresh cilantro and slices of chili.
Press together and serve immediately.
